H3 (explicit decline statement): This challenge is directly refuted. Evidence E2 explicitly states "Greater China net sales increased during the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same quarter in 2025 primarily due to higher net sales of iPhone and Services." This confirms the increase shown in the numerical table.

The claim states that Greater China net sales declined year over year for Q1 FY2026 (quarter ended December 27, 2025). The evidence clearly shows Greater China net sales were $25,526 million in Q1 2026 versus $18,513 million in Q1 2025, representing a 38% increase. The filing also explicitly states this was an increase. Therefore, the claim is contradicted by the evidence.
